title: Chapter 4 — AI practice quiz 3
instructions: Short original AI-authored practice; not an official or teacher paper. Self-mark using the guidance after submission.
description: Three original questions with self-marking guidance.

questions.text: What is held in the current instruction register?

answer.text: The instruction currently being decoded or executed.

questions.text: State the purpose of the data bus.

answer.text: It carries data and instructions between components.

questions.text: What does the control bus carry?

answer.text: Control and timing signals between system components.
